title: Eigenstate-Selective Entangled Two-Photon Absorption in Monolayer WSe$_2$
summary: We show that the Bell-state phase of a polarization-entangled photon pair controls the biexciton eigenstate distribution produced by entangled two-photon absorption in monolayer WSe$_2$. In a frequency-nondegenerate ladder scheme, two independent valley pathways ($K$ and $K'$) share no intermediate state, so the biphoton phase sets the relative amplitude between them. Within the valley-symmetric limit, the phase dependence is contained in the prefactors $1\pm e^{i\varphi}$, which are independent of the material response.
